description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Row' which is used for rendering a flexible row layout with various alignment and distribution options. It includes styling, template, and input property definitions.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: An Angular component extending DynamicComponent to render a flexible, configurable row layout with alignment and distribution options.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property for the alignment setting of the row, defaulting to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property for the distribution (justification) setting of the row, defaulting to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: A computed property that returns the CSS classes for the component based on theme and input properties.
